game_title: Function Test Arena – Firewood Stacks Trial
game_concept: A puzzle set in Snowy Hold – Firewood Stacks, towering firewood stacks: the frost mage must handle winter bandits while practicing functions. Core idea – Function Test Arena: Write quick assert tests to confirm functions behave before facing winter bandits.
theme: Snowy Hold – Firewood Stacks: towering firewood stacks
core_gameplay_loop: In Firewood Stacks, repeat each round: Write quick assert tests to confirm functions behave before facing winter bandits. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the tests_passed value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the frozen well using at most 16 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The frozen well reached with actions_used <= 16.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 16 before the frozen well is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 4 (applied tier): Function Test Arena
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how tests_passed changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against winter bandits in Firewood Stacks.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The frozen well reached with actions_used <= 16.
